subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: Should #8969 remain one umbrella issue or be split into focused status-diagnostics and skill prompt-rewrite warning follow-ups, and which operator surface should carry the prompt-rewrite warning?
rationale: Current main resolves only the skills-check portion; the remaining prompt-rewrite warning needs maintainer intent because the wrong surface could either hide useful debugging context or add noisy user-visible output.

options.title: Split And Keep Both
options.body: Track status registry diagnostics and the prompt-rewrite warning as two focused follow-ups while keeping this issue as the umbrella or closing it after links are created.

options.title: Implement Both Here
options.body: Keep the umbrella open until one change lands status text/JSON/all diagnostics plus a chosen prompt-rewrite diagnostic surface.

options.title: Status Only
options.body: Proceed with status registry diagnostics and decline the prompt-rewrite warning if maintainers decide it would be too noisy or belongs in debug tooling only.

recommendation.title: Split And Keep Both
recommendation.body: Track status registry diagnostics and the prompt-rewrite warning as two focused follow-ups while keeping this issue as the umbrella or closing it after links are created.

likelyOwner.reason: They already posted the maintainer-context review on this issue and are the clearest routing candidate for deciding whether to split the remaining work.
